items.description: Fix scoped/default BM25 query plan: replace the collection-filtered FTS join with a MATERIALIZED FTS match CTE so `sif search search` and `sif query` no longer degrade to the per-document `SCAN fts ... :=M1` plan; add a regression test on a multi-collection fixture preserving default scoring.

Align release identity to 1.1.1: single-source the version across pyproject.toml, src/sif/__init__.py, src/sif/_version.py, src/sif/cli/__init__.py, src/sif/config/constants.py, and src/sif/mcp/protocol.py; add a changelog entry; correct install/upgrade/uninstall docs and in-app hints to use the `docsif` distribution name.

Fix detached-daemon identity for console-script installs: `sif watch --stop` and `sif status` must corroborate a daemon launched via the installed `sif` entry point, not only `python -m sif.cli.main`; add a subprocess e2e test covering the console-script argv shape.

Fix `sif watch --embed` startup reconcile: the pre-observer pass currently runs BM25-only and can leave changed documents vector-less; route startup through the embed-aware reconcile path and add a regression test proving no embedding-less documents remain after startup.

Clean the Broken Windows ledger: re-validate every open entry, mark the two caplog entries fixed (re-run result: 31 passed), waive the deliberate HuggingFace stub and the API-key manual check with explicit reasons, and fix or waive the group-callback mkdir side effect.
